context: Riku-teen tells Sho-young his future career dreams excitedly.
purpose: Teen sharing future ambitions with younger friend.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 俺、将来、警察になりたいんよ。
lines.en: I want to be a police officer someday.
lines.style: Quiet, genuine conviction. Slight hesitation before committing to the words—testing them out, seeing if they sound real. Warm but not performed. A moment of real hope underneath.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Bright, immediate awe. The second word rises with genuine surprise and admiration. Unguarded enthusiasm—a kid who hasn't learned to hide what he thinks.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 頑張って、勉強せなあかん。
lines.en: So I have to study hard.
lines.style: Softer, more to himself than to Sho. Matter-of-fact acknowledgment of what needs to happen. Not complaining—just naming the requirement. Steady resolve.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.style: Bright burst of sincerity. Not performing—just offering it completely. The kind of simple loyalty a younger kid gives without calculation. Quick, warm.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.style: Touched, quiet. The gratitude lands—he lets it in. A moment where his cool slips just enough to show he needed that. Slight exhale, genuine.
